frozen_oracle_origin.scope: reuse only native expected replies with identical weights, reference executable/libraries and reference settings; every ZINC continuation and HTTP replay is rerun on the new archive

interpretation.earlier_failures: Earlier archives, client budgets and stale-PWD trials remain separate retained evidence; none is replaced by this matrix.
interpretation.scope: Actual OpenCode 2.0.21 over SSH against one exact CI Vulkan archive. These bounded tasks do not certify a release candidate or general coding ability.
